mapper.select: SELECT FROM alert_states WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId} AND server_id = #{serverId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_states (rule_id, server_id, active, breach_count, alert_record_id, first_triggered_at, last_triggered_at, version) VALUES (#{state.ruleId}, #{state.serverId}, #{state.active}, #{state.breachCount}, #{state.alertRecordId}, #{state.firstTriggeredAt}, #{state.lastTriggeredAt}, #{state.version})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM alert_states WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
